__inputs.name: DS_PROMETHEUS
__inputs.label: Prometheus
__inputs.description: Prometheus data source scraping Solti agents.

description: Single-pane Solti agent fleet overview. Health, fleet table, workload phases, activity, lifecycle, admission, event bus, API, discovery, host.

panels.title: Agents
panels.description: Live agent processes. Counts distinct scrape targets that reported build_info in the last ~5 min.

panels.title: Throughput
panels.description: Tasks spawned per second across the fleet.

panels.title: Task p95
panels.description: 95% of task attempts finish in under this time (5m window).

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(solti_runner_task_duration_seconds_bucket[5m]) * on (instance) group_left(agent) solti_build_info{agent=~"$agent"}))

panels.title: Error rate
panels.description: Fraction of task completions with outcome ≠ success (5m).

targets.expr: 1 - (sum(rate(solti_runner_tasks_completed_total{outcome="success"}[5m]) * on (instance) group_left(agent) solti_build_info{agent=~"$agent"}) / clamp_min(sum(rate(solti_runner_tasks_completed_total[5m]) * on (instance) group_left(agent) solti_build_info{agent=~"$agent"}), 1e-9))

panels.title: Fleet
panels.description: Per-agent snapshot. Rows auto-disappear ~5 min after the target stops being scraped (Prometheus staleness).

targets.expr: up{job="solti-agent"} * on (instance) group_left(agent, host, version) solti_build_info{agent=~"$agent"}
(sum by (instance) (solti_sv_tasks_in_flight)) * on (instance) group_left(agent, host, version) solti_build_info{agent=~"$agent"}
(sum by (instance) (rate(solti_runner_tasks_started_total[1m]))) * on (instance) group_left(agent, host, version) solti_build_info{agent=~"$agent"}

((sum by (instance) (rate(solti_runner_tasks_completed_total{outcome="success"}[5m]))) / clamp_min((sum by (instance) (rate(solti_runner_tasks_completed_total[5m]))), 1e-9)) * on (instance) group_left(agent, host, version) solti_build_info{agent=~"$agent"}
(time() - (max by (instance) (solti_discover_last_success_timestamp_seconds))) * on (instance) group_left(agent, host, version) solti_build_info{agent=~"$agent"}

panels.title: Availability
panels.description: Per-agent up/down timeline. Green = scrape OK, red = scrape failing.

panels.title: Phases now
panels.description: Current task count by phase — donut snapshot.

panels.title: Phases over time
panels.description: Stacked timeline of how tasks are distributed across phases.

panels.title: Outcomes
panels.description: Rate at which tasks finish, split by how they finished: success / failure / canceled / timeout.

panels.title: Duration percentiles
panels.description: p50 / p95 / p99 of task attempt duration (5m rolling).

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le) (rate(solti_runner_task_duration_seconds_bucket[5m]) * on (instance) group_left(agent) solti_build_info{agent=~"$agent"}))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(solti_runner_task_duration_seconds_bucket[5m]) * on (instance) group_left(agent) solti_build_info{agent=~"$agent"}))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(solti_runner_task_duration_seconds_bucket[5m]) * on (instance) group_left(agent) solti_build_info{agent=~"$agent"}))

panels.title: Duration heatmap
panels.description: Where task durations cluster. X = time, Y = duration bucket (log-ish), color intensity = number of attempts that finished in that bucket during that minute.

panels.title: Cycles by source
panels.description: Backoff-scheduled re-runs per second, split by what triggered them. `success` = scheduled task reached the end of a cycle and is restarting on schedule (normal for periodic tasks). `failure` = attempt errored and the supervisor is retrying (flapping if this stays high). A one-shot task with restart=Never shows 0 here.

panels.title: Terminal & timeouts
panels.description: These are actual dead ends. `exhausted` = retry budget spent, task won't be restarted. `fatal` = task raised a non-retryable error. `timeout` = attempt exceeded its per-run deadline.

panels.title: In vs rejected
panels.description: Divergent view: positive = submissions accepted into the supervisor. Negative = submissions rejected by admission policy (slot busy, queue full, etc).

targets.expr: sum(rate(solti_ctrl_submissions_total[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance) group_left(agent) solti_build_info{agent=~"$agent"}) - sum(rate(solti_ctrl_rejections_total[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance) group_left(agent) solti_build_info{agent=~"$agent"})

panels.title: Rejection reasons
panels.description: Why submissions get rejected: `slot_busy` = a task already runs in that slot; `slot_full` = queue capped; `bus_lagged` = event bus fell behind; `add_failed`/`remove_failed` = internal registry error.

panels.title: Event throughput
panels.description: Rate of supervisor events, stacked by kind. This is the work the event bus is carrying.

targets.expr: sum(rate(solti_ctrl_submissions_total[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance) group_left(agent) solti_build_info{agent=~"$agent"}) + sum(rate(solti_ctrl_rejections_total[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance) group_left(agent) solti_build_info{agent=~"$agent"})

panels.title: Lost events
panels.description: Events that were dropped because a subscriber couldn't keep up (overflow) or crashed (panic). Non-zero here means metrics / logs are incomplete.

panels.title: Requests by status
panels.description: Client-facing API traffic. Green = 2xx/gRPC OK, yellow = 4xx, red = 5xx/gRPC non-zero.

targets.expr: sum by (transport, status) (rate(solti_api_requests_total[$__rate_interval]) * on (instance) group_left(agent) solti_build_info{agent=~"$agent"})

panels.title: API latency
panels.description: Heatmap of request latency across all routes. Bright bands = dominant latency bucket right now.

panels.title: Heartbeats
panels.description: Rate of heartbeats sent to the control-plane (Podium). Green = success, red = failure.

panels.title: Failure reasons
panels.description: Why heartbeats fail: `connect` = can't reach control-plane, `timeout` = too slow, `rejected_*` = CP returned error, `parse` = bad payload, `auth` = credential issue.

panels.title: CPU
panels.description: Process CPU time rate. 1.0 = one full core.

panels.title: RSS
panels.description: Resident memory used by the agent process.

panels.title: FDs
panels.description: Open file descriptors as a fraction of the process limit.

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: Wall-clock age of the agent process.

title: Solti Agent Overview
